items.title: 1.9 Home Network Setup and Configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Home Network Setup and Configuration' (PDF 16): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Home network (ghar ka network) ghar ke mukhtalif devices ko jorne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh computers, mobile phones aur printers ko aapas mein communicate (baat) karne mein madad deta hai. Saare devices ek hi internet connection share kar sakte hain. Router home network ka main (sab se ahem) device hai. Network setup (network lagana) data sharing ko aasan aur tez banata hai. Proper configuration (sahi settings) network ki speed aur safety (hifazat) behtar karti hai.

blocks.alt: ISP ka badal modem se, modem router se jura hai; router se Ethernet cable wired computer tak jati hai, aur laptop aur phone Wi-Fi se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Ghar ka network: ISP, modem, router, wired aur Wi-Fi devices (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Home network ka main device kaun sa hai, aur sahi configuration se kya faida hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Router. Sahi configuration se network ki speed aur hifazat behtar hoti hai.

items: Home network: ghar ke devices ek internet connection share karte hain; router main device; sahi settings = speed aur safety.
